当火车再次减速的时候，王建新从空间里往外看了一眼。

外面的景象不一样了。不再是荒凉的雪原和零星的小站，而是密密麻麻的建筑、宽阔的街道、来来往往的车辆。楼房高了，路宽了，人也多了。虽然天快黑了，但城市里灯火通明，跟之前经过的那些地方完全不是一个档次。

“莫斯科。”王建新心里有数了。

这一路从边境过来，坐火车坐了好几天，穿过了大半个苏联，终于到了首都。莫斯科，苏联的心脏，这个年代世界上最大的城市之一。这里的物资，肯定比乌兰巴托强了不知道多少倍。

“看来该行动了。”王建新在心里盘算了一下，“不过不能在车站直接就开搞，得先去城里转一转。”

火车进站了，缓缓停在了铁轨上。王建新没有第一时间下车，而是躲在空间里观察了一会儿。车站里人来人往，有旅客有工作人员，还有穿着军装的警卫。他等了一会儿，也没人来卸车，不知道这列木材火车是要在这儿停多久。

他一直等到天彻底黑了，才从空间里出来。趁着站台上没人注意，轻飘飘地跳下车，绕出车站，来到了莫斯科市区。

莫斯科的夜晚比乌兰巴托热闹多了。街上灯火通明，霓虹灯招牌闪来闪去，汽车一辆接一辆地过。路两边是高大的建筑，有的是老式的石头楼房，有的是新式的斯大林式建筑，尖顶、大柱子、浮雕，看着就气派。行人裹着厚大衣，匆匆忙忙地走着，谁也不看谁。

王建新穿了一件苏联军大衣套在外面，又戴上一顶皮帽子，把脸遮住了大半。这样看着就像个普通的苏联军人，不仔细看看不出来。

他在莫斯科的街头转悠了一会儿。城市太大了，他一时半会儿不知道该去哪儿。百货大楼肯定要去，但莫斯科的百货大楼不止一家，得找最大的。库房也要去，但库房在哪儿他不知道。

转着转着，他来到了一片很大的园区。门口有牌子，上面写着俄文——莫斯科主植物园科研机构。

“植物园？”王建新站在暗处看了看，心里一动。

植物园里有各种植物，有树有花有草，还有温室大棚。他正愁空间里缺树苗呢，上次就想着要搞点树苗种在空间里，一直没机会。这儿不就有了吗？

植物园的防卫并不严。门口有个看门的，但老头在屋里打瞌睡。围墙也不高，翻过去很容易。王建新找了个没人的地方，轻轻一跃，翻过围墙，落进了植物园里。

植物园很大，黑灯瞎火的，只能看见各种树木的轮廓。王建新转了一会儿，找到了温室大棚区。一排玻璃温室，在月光下闪着光。

他悄悄潜进第一个温室大棚。

一进去，暖气扑面而来。温室里亮着灯，温度比外面高了不知道多少度，暖烘烘的，空气里弥漫着泥土和植物的气息。一排一排的植物，整整齐齐地种在花盆和苗床里，有的已经长成了大树，有的还是小苗。

王建新眼睛亮了。

苹果树、杏树、梨树、樱桃树、李子树、沙棘、桃树、醋梅、树莓、葡萄、草莓——各种果树，应有尽有。有的他认识，有的他不认识，但一看就是好东西。那些果树有的已经挂果了，红红绿绿的果子挂在枝头，看着就馋人。

“居然还有草莓。”王建新蹲下来看了看地上的草莓苗，绿油油的叶子，白色的小花，红艳艳的果子。他摘了一颗放进嘴里，酸甜酸甜的，好吃。

王建新每样搞了五棵，专挑大的、长得壮实的来。他蹲在苗床边上，用手轻轻地把土扒开，把树苗连根带土挖出来，收入空间。五棵苹果树、五棵杏树、五棵梨树、五棵樱桃树、五棵李子树、五棵沙棘、五棵桃树、五棵醋梅、五棵树莓、五棵葡萄、草莓多收一点——全部收入空间。

“反正空间肯定都能活。”王建新拍了拍手上的土，心里美得很。这些树苗种下去，用不了几年，他就能吃上各种水果了。

第一个温室搞定了，他去了第二个温室。

第二个温室里的东西更稀罕。他看见牌子上的介绍——莫斯科杏。这是苏联培育的品种，耐寒，果个大，味道甜。还有黑果腺肋花楸，也叫不老莓，上面介绍说这东西营养价值高，能抗氧化、降血压。旁边还有西伯利亚雪松、满洲龙牙、山楂树、卫矛、橡树、椴树、丁香。

王建新每样也搞了几棵。有介绍牌就好办了，不用他自己猜是什么东西。照着牌子上的名字，挑好的挖。

第三个温室是玫瑰园。各种玫瑰花，红的、白的、黄的、粉的，大的小的，单瓣的重瓣的，看得他眼花缭乱。他不懂玫瑰的品种，但看着好看的，每样搞几棵。种在空间里，以后开花了好闻好看。

旁边还有几个温室，里面主要是观赏花卉。好多他都不认识，叫不上名字，但看着漂亮就搞一些。反正是植物园的，肯定都是好东西。

搞完了温室，王建新找到了种子库。植物园的种子库里有各种种子，分门别类地存放在柜子里。他翻了翻，找到了番茄、黄瓜的种子，还有一些根茎类蔬菜的种子，全部拿走。

王建新把种子收好，出了植物园。

植物园这一趟收获不小，但这不是他的主要目标。莫斯科真正的宝贝，在市区的商店里。

王建新顺着外面的街道，开着嘎斯69，慢慢转悠着。莫斯科的夜晚对他来说跟白天差不多，炼气三层的视力，黑暗里什么都看得清清楚楚。

转着转着，他来到了一条很宽的大街。街两边的建筑都很气派，不是普通的居民楼，而是那种带雕塑、带柱子的豪华建筑。街口有个牌子，上面写着“特维尔大街”。

“特维尔大街。”王建新念了一遍，记住了这个名字。

他在大街上走了一段，看见一栋特别显眼的建筑。不是那种朴素的苏联建筑，而是装饰得很奢华的那种，金色的、白色的，在路灯下闪闪发亮。门口挂着招牌——叶利谢耶夫斯基商店。

“这家商店感觉特别奢华。”王建新停在街对面看了看。商店的门面很大，有好几个橱窗，里面摆着各种商品。虽然是晚上，但橱窗的灯还亮着，把里面的东西照得清清楚楚。

把车收入空间，他找到了这家商店的后院。后院不大，有几间房和一个货运入口。围墙不高，翻过去很容易。王建新利用空间几个瞬移，就穿过围墙，进到了商店里面。

商店很大。从外面看是三层楼，但进来以后发现，里面是一个巨大的大厅，挑高差不多有十来米，顶上吊着水晶灯，墙上贴着金色的壁纸，柱子是白色的大理石，雕着花纹。地上铺着大理石地砖，亮得能照出人影。

“就像一个古典的宫殿。”王建新站在大厅里，四下看了看。

When the train slowed down again, Wang Jianxin looked out from the space.

The scene outside is different.It is no longer a desolate snowfield and scattered small stations, but densely packed buildings, wide streets, and vehicles coming and going.The buildings are taller, the roads are wider, and there are more people.Although it was getting dark, the lights in the city were brightly lit, which was completely different from the places we had passed before.

"Moscow." Wang Jianxin knew it well.

This journey came from the border, took a train for several days, passed through most of the Soviet Union, and finally arrived in the capital.Moscow, the heart of the Soviet Union, was one of the largest cities in the world at this time.The supplies here are definitely many times better than those in Ulaanbaatar.

"It seems it's time to take action." Wang Jianxin thought about it in his mind, "But we can't do it directly at the station. We have to go to the city first."

The train entered the station and slowly stopped on the tracks.Wang Jianxin did not get out of the car immediately, but hid in the space and observed for a while.There were people coming and going in the station, including passengers, staff, and guards in military uniforms.He waited for a while, but no one came to unload the truck. He didn't know how long the lumber train would stay here.

He waited until it was completely dark before coming out of the space.Taking advantage of the fact that no one was paying attention on the platform, I jumped out of the car lightly, walked around the station, and arrived in downtown Moscow.

Moscow is much more lively at night than Ulaanbaatar.The streets were brightly lit, neon signs flashed here and there, and cars passed one after another.There are tall buildings on both sides of the road, some are old-fashioned stone buildings, and some are new Stalin-style buildings, with spires, large pillars, and reliefs, which look majestic.Pedestrians were wrapped in thick coats and walked in a hurry without looking at anyone.

Wang Jianxin wore a Soviet army coat and a leather hat, covering most of his face.This looks like an ordinary Soviet soldier, and you can't tell it without looking carefully.

He wandered around the streets of Moscow for a while.The city was so big that he didn't know where to go for a while.You must go to a department store, but there are more than one department store in Moscow, so you have to find the biggest one.He also wanted to go to the warehouse, but he didn't know where it was.

After turning around, he came to a large park.There is a sign at the door that says in Russian - Scientific Research Institution of the Moscow Main Botanical Garden.

"Botanical Garden?" Wang Jianxin stood in the dark and looked around, his heart moved.

There are various plants in the botanical garden, including trees, flowers, grass, and greenhouses.He was worried about the lack of saplings in the space. Last time he thought about getting some saplings to plant in the space, but he never had the chance.Isn’t it already here?

The Botanic Gardens are not well defended.There was a janitor at the door, but the old man was dozing inside.The wall is not high and it is easy to climb over.Wang Jianxin found a deserted place, jumped lightly, climbed over the wall, and fell into the botanical garden.

The botanical garden is very large, and in the dark, only the outlines of various trees can be seen.Wang Jianxin walked around for a while and found the greenhouse area.A row of glass greenhouses shone in the moonlight.

He quietly sneaked into the first greenhouse.

As soon as I walked in, the warmth hit my face.The lights were on in the greenhouse, and the temperature was who knows how many degrees higher than outside. It was warm, and the air was filled with the smell of earth and plants.Rows of plants are planted neatly in flower pots and seedbeds. Some have grown into big trees, and some are still small seedlings.

Wang Jianxin's eyes lit up.

Apple trees, apricot trees, pear trees, cherry trees, plum trees, sea buckthorn, peach trees, vinegar plums, raspberries, grapes, strawberries - all kinds of fruit trees.Some of them he knew, some he didn't know, but they were good things at first glance.Some of those fruit trees are already bearing fruit, and the red and green fruits are hanging on the branches, which makes people greedy just looking at them.

"There are actually strawberries." Wang Jianxin squatted down and looked at the strawberry seedlings on the ground, with green leaves, white flowers and bright red fruits.He picked one and put it in his mouth. It was sweet and sour and delicious.

Wang Jianxin planted five trees of each type, choosing only big and strong ones.He squatted beside the seedling bed, gently peeled away the soil with his hands, dug out the saplings with their roots and soil, and put them into the space.Five apple trees, five apricot trees, five pear trees, five cherry trees, five plum trees, five sea buckthorn trees, five peach trees, five vinegar plum trees, five raspberries, five grape trees, and a little more strawberry - all income space.

"Anyway, we can definitely survive in space." Wang Jianxin patted the dirt on his hands, feeling very happy.If these saplings are planted, he will be able to eat various fruits within a few years.

After finishing the first greenhouse, he went to the second greenhouse.

The contents of the second greenhouse are even rarer.He saw the introduction on the brand - Moscow apricot.This variety was developed in the Soviet Union. It is cold-resistant, has large fruits and a sweet taste.There is also Sorbus nigra, also called eternal berry. It is said above that it has high nutritional value and can resist oxidation and lower blood pressure.Next to it are Siberian cedar, Manchurian Aralia, hawthorn, euonymus, oak, linden, and lilac.

Wang Jianxin also made several trees of each kind.It would be easier if there is an introduction card, so he doesn't have to guess what it is.Pick out the ones according to the name on the sign.

The third greenhouse is a rose garden.All kinds of roses, red, white, yellow, pink, big and small, single and double, dazzled him.He didn't know the varieties of roses, but he bought a few of each kind that looked good.Plant it in space and it will bloom and smell good.

There are several greenhouses next to it, which mainly contain ornamental flowers.He didn't recognize many of them and couldn't name them, but he did some because they looked pretty.Anyway, it's from the Botanical Garden, so it must be good stuff.

After finishing the greenhouse, Wang Jianxin found the seed bank.There are various seeds in the seed bank of the botanical garden, which are stored in cabinets by category.He rummaged through and found tomatoes, cucumber seeds, and some root vegetable seeds, and took them all.

Wang Jianxin collected the seeds and left the botanical garden.

This trip to the botanical garden was quite rewarding, but it was not his main goal.A real treasure of Moscow, in the shops in the city.

Wang Jianxin drove his GAZ 69 along the street outside and drove around slowly.The night in Moscow was almost the same as the day to him, and with his third-level Qi refining vision, he could see everything clearly in the darkness.

After turning around, he came to a very wide street.The buildings on both sides of the street are very impressive. They are not ordinary residential buildings, but luxurious buildings with sculptures and pillars.There is a sign at the corner of the street that says "Tverskaya Street".

"Tver Street." Wang Jianxin read it again and remembered the name.

He walked for a while on the street and saw a particularly conspicuous building.Not the plain Soviet architecture, but the luxuriously decorated one, gold and white, shining under the street lights.A sign hung at the door - Yeliseyevsky Store.

"This store feels very luxurious." Wang Jianxin stopped across the street and took a look.The store has a large facade with several windows displaying various products.Although it was night, the lights in the display windows were still on, illuminating the contents clearly.

Putting his car into the space, he found the store's backyard.The backyard is small, with a few rooms and a cargo entrance.The wall is not high and it is easy to climb over.Wang Jianxin used the space to teleport a few times, walked through the wall and entered the store.

The store is huge.From the outside it looks like it has three floors, but when you come in, you find that it is a huge hall inside, with a ceiling height of almost ten meters, crystal chandeliers hanging from the top, golden wallpaper on the walls, and white marble pillars with carved patterns.The floor was paved with marble tiles, so bright that figures could be seen.

"It's like a classical palace." Wang Jianxin stood in the hall and looked around.
